name: phone-ref
description: Drop an image or video on your computer, see it instantly on your iPhone. Zoom, history, IG preview.
author: Mike Clark (https://mikeclark.design)

scripts.build:win: node build.mjs && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 dist/phone-ref.mjs --outfile dist/phone-ref.exe
scripts.build:mac: node build.mjs && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 dist/phone-ref.mjs --outfile dist/phone-ref-mac-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 dist/phone-ref.mjs --outfile dist/phone-ref-mac-intel
